tasks.label: check-missing-php-includes
args: $root=(Get-Location).Path; $files=Get-ChildItem -Recurse -File -Filter *.php; $missing=@(); foreach($f in $files){ $content=Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $f.FullName; $matches=[regex]::Matches($content,'(?m)(require|include)(_once)?\s*\(?\s*[\"\'']([^\"\'']+)[\"\'']\s*\)?\s*;'); foreach($m in $matches){ $p=$m.Groups[3].Value; if($p -match '^https?://'){continue}; if($p -like '*$*'){continue}; $resolved=Join-Path $f.DirectoryName $p; if(-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $resolved)){ $missing += [pscustomobject]@{ File=$f.FullName; Ref=$p; Resolved=$resolved } } } }; if($missing.Count -eq 0){ 'INCLUDE_CHECK_OK' } else { $missing | ForEach-Object { "MISSING_INCLUDE|$($_.File)|$($_.Ref)|$($_.Resolved)" } }

tasks.label: runtime-smoke-http-check
args: $base='http://localhost/online_voting_system_1'; $pages=@('/index.html','/login.php','/register.php','/forgot_password.php','/check_verification.php','/results.php','/ballot.php','/voter_account.php','/change_location.php','/admin_login.php','/admin_verify_voters.php','/admin_manage_voters.php','/admin_records.php','/admin_candidate_change_history.php','/api/get_constituencies.php?county_id=1','/api/get_wards.php?constituency_id=1'); foreach($p in $pages){ try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri ($base+$p) -MaximumRedirection 5 -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 15; $code=[int]$r.StatusCode; $len=($r.Content|Out-String).Length; Write-Output ("SMOKE_OK|{0}|{1}|{2}" -f $p,$code,$len) } catch { $resp=$_.Exception.Response; if($resp){ $code=[int]$resp.StatusCode; Write-Output ("SMOKE_HTTP_FAIL|{0}|{1}" -f $p,$code) } else { Write-Output ("SMOKE_FAIL|{0}|{1}" -f $p,$_.Exception.Message) } } }
